changes_from_live: zip \d{5}(?:\d{2})? -> \d{7}. Israel Post replaced 5-digit codes with 7-digit codes (mikud) on 1 Feb 2013; 5-digit codes stopped being valid on 31 Jan 2013, and UPU lists Israel as 9999999 only. If we want to accept old input, keep the legacy form only as a warning, not as valid.
fmt: '%C %Z' -> '%Z %C' for Latin-script/international addresses (UPU 10/2022: '9414219 JERUSALEM', '7178437 Modiin-Maccabim-Reut')
final.notes: The live posturl (israelpost.co.il/zipcode.nsf) is outdated. UPU says the 7-digit code goes 'to the left of locality name'. In Latin script that means before the locality ('9414219 JERUSALEM'). In Hebrew (RTL) the code displayed on the left is logically after the city, so a Hebrew-script local layout would be '%C %Z'. This schema has one layout field, so it follows the UPU Latin example.

decisions.layout: accepted checker: isrEn.pdf (10/2022) says '7 digits to the left of locality name' and prints '9414219 JERUSALEM' and '7178437 Modiin-Maccabim-Reut'. The Israel Post business page the checker cited returned 403, so its wording is unverified, but the UPU sheet alone settles the Latin-script order. Note: '%C %Z' is correct only as the logical order of a Hebrew RTL address.

dropped_tokens.%D: Gu/gun (district) within a city. In Korean addresses it sits between city and road name; drop it and the road-name address may be ambiguous in big cities, so if we drop %D it must be typed into the street line.

province.subdivision_list: issues: 16 current first-level units, not 17. From 1 Jul 2026, 전라남도 (KR-46) and 광주광역시 (KR-29) were abolished and merged into 전남광주통합특별시 (short name 광주특별시); no ISO 3166-2 code yet. Keep '전라남도' and '광주광역시' only as input aliases. Also KR-42 is 강원특별자치도 (from 11 Jun 2023) and KR-45 is 전북특별자치도 (from 18 Jan 2024), with codes unchanged.

changes_from_live: sub_keys: 강원도 -> 강원특별자치도 and 전라북도 -> 전북특별자치도 (renamed Special Self-Governing Provinces in 2023 and 2024).

sub_keys: replace 전라남도 and 광주광역시 with 전남광주통합특별시 (merged 1 Jul 2026 under the 전남광주통합특별시 설치를 위한 특별법). Addresses become '전남광주통합특별시 여수시' and '전남광주통합특별시 동구'. Accept the old names as aliases and show the new one.
Keep the ISO code question open: no ISO 3166-2 code has been published for the merged city.

The ISO newsletter of 2023-11-23 changed only the KR-42 category; ISO still calls KR-45 Jeollabuk-do and has nothing for the 2026 merger. The UPU international examples (03/2016) put the province + postcode last ('DAEGU 42007'). The large-to-small layout here is the domestic Korean order.

zip: Decreto n.º 74/2024 (BR I Série nº 183, 18 Sep 2024, in force on publication, revokes Decreto 28/2019) sets the CEP at 8 digits, 5 + hyphen + 3. Pattern \d{5}-\d{3}, pending a published code list.
zipex: live 1102/1119/3212 and UPU 2005 1100/3314 are old 4-digit codes; no official 8-digit sample has been published yet.
final.notes: Decreto 74/2024 Art. 3 structure: zone (1 Sul / 2 Centro / 3 Norte), province (0 = Cidade de Maputo, 0-4 by zone), urban/non-urban flag, district or city (2), administrative post (1), locality or bairro (2). Maputo city has its own variant: city (2), municipal district (1), municipal admin post (1), bairro (1). Maputo city codes therefore begin '10'. Correios de Moçambique was dissolved in 2021; CORRE (Decreto 34/2024) is the designated operator. INCM's own footer still shows 'CEP: 0102-07', which fits neither the decree nor the 4-digit system. The UPU Aug 2026 table still lists 9999. Envelope layout is from the 2005 UPU sheet; no newer sample was found.

decisions.postal.pattern: unresolved: official sources conflict. The final entry uses \d{5}-\d{3}, the best-supported value, which is neither side's proposal. Decreto n.º 74/2024 (INCM legislação postal download 556, BR I Série nº 183) Art. 3(1) says 'composto por oito algarismos, separados por um travessão em dois grupos ... o primeiro de cinco e o segundo de três'. It is in force on publication (Art. 9) and revokes Decreto 28/2019 (Art. 8). The proposal's \d{4} rests on the UPU 03/2005 sheet and on the UPU Aug 2026 table (still '9999'). The checker's \d{4}-\d{2} rests only on INCM's own address footer 'CEP: 0102-07', which does not fit the decree's structure (Maputo city = zone 1, province 0). No published code list or real 8-digit code was found, and UPU has not been updated.
decisions.postal.examples: unresolved: rejected both. 1100/3314 are 2005 4-digit codes, and 0102-07 contradicts Decreto 74/2024. No real code under the decree has been published, and I did not invent one. Examples left empty.

Mark postcodes as in use but do not add %Z to the layout, require it, or validate it until the format is published in the Gaceta Oficial (still pending at launch per La Estrella).

final.notes: Portal evidence is inconsistent. Its UI caption says 'Código completo XXXX-XXXX', but the search placeholder says 'Ej. A31234-5678 o solo grilla (8 caracteres)'. The live API (/api/location, fetched 2026-11-01) returns alphanumeric 5+5 codes: codigo_completo 'A7C95-69R3E' (Bella Vista, estafeta World Trade Center) and 'I2GW2-EKJ3Z' (David), with separate 'codigo' (A6132, I2026) and 'codigo_prefijo' (A7, I2). There is no published format and no Gaceta decree; the UPU Aug 2026 table still says 9999 (old zone numbers). Layout is left without %Z: no official envelope sample shows where the new code goes, so add %Z only once the format and position are published. UPU 02/2015 layout is locality, then 'PROVINCIA DE X'.

decisions.postal.uses: accepted checker (true): the operator's own release (correospanama.gob.pa, 7 May 2026) launches the Sistema Nacional de Códigos Postales and points to codigospostalespanama.gob.pa, and UPU news (Aug 2026) describes Panama's National Georeferenced Postcode System. Z stays optional because La Estrella (launch day) quotes the director saying the Executive signature and Gaceta Oficial publication were still pending, and no later Gaceta text was found.
decisions.postal.pattern: unresolved: the checker's \d{4}-?\d{4} is contradicted by the portal's own data.
